status: PREPARED; local focused verification passed; not published or deployed
scope: Actual member web components with synthetic Auth/database/storage/functions and Next routing adapters. No hosted/provider acceptance or real mutations.

literalBaseline.outcome: Expected regression failures with the final harness against untouched baseline production entry imports

scopedLint.scope: The fifteen frozen TypeScript/TSX/CJS files; CSS excluded from ESLint

verification.coverage: Normal, resolved-error and rejected-error reads; retained drafts and successful retries; actual cover-button pointer/file-chooser path at both widths.

repairs.result: Hidden/muted-word arrays cannot be overwritten from unknown initial state. Failed reads expose retry and disable editing; failed saves preserve the draft and confirmed list.
Standing read failures expose retry and never assert clean standing.
Explore required read failures settle to a recoverable visible error.
Topic failures are distinguished from genuine empty posts, including returned and rejected errors.
Search trending-topic failure is visible and retryable. The baseline retained input/back controls; the defect was silent discovery-content failure, not an entirely blank page.
Listing and business unexpected mutation rejections release submission controls; user inputs survive and retry succeeds. Market availability read failure is distinct from disabled or enabled.
Promotion own-content errors remain visible across wizard steps; retry preserves goal and selection state.
Unread/FeaturedChannels/ExploreTopics no longer leak rejected reads; accessible recovery surfaces and retry or next-poll recovery are covered.
Cover action stacking allows actual center-pointer activation and a file chooser at 390 and 1440 CSS-pixel widths. Visual pixels can be identical while pointer interception differs.

intermediateHarnessCorrections: A first candidate run reported45 pass/3 fail because the synthetic get_channels adapter returned no populated row; the adapter now supplies a valid channel and all three normal/retry paths pass. This was not classified as a production defect.

The baseline clean checkout lacked node_modules; one compile attempt failed before cases. A temporary dependency symlink to the existing locked installation enabled the final run and was removed. No baseline tracked source changed.
The final microtask effect-start adjustment was followed by fresh48-case candidate and31-case baseline runs plus final TypeScript/lint. Repeated runs are not added to the48-case total.

findings: Primitive/stable effect dependencies and effect cleanup guards used for new reads.
Independent Explore reads remain parallel; no new global cache or listener ownership.
Unknown whole-array preferences disable mutation rather than inventing empty state.
Submission locks release through finally; failed mutation does not claim success.
Errors and retry controls are accessible; cover action is verified through real pointer hit testing.

limits: Synthetic Auth/database/storage/functions and Next routing adapters execute actual production components. This does not verify hosted RLS, signed-in sessions, deployment, real payments, uploads or external services.
No new write deadline or automatic mutation retry is introduced; held mutation timeout behavior remains outside this focused change.
Account/route lifecycle coverage uses existing application boundary contracts; this fixture is not a full Next account-switch/ABA integration proof.
The first-pass inventory still has explicitly unexecuted routes/deep/provider contracts. These48 focused cases do not mean every product control is covered.
No native theme changes, Support changes, shared readDeadline changes, provider data mutations or ref updates are included.
